quote: The driver of any motor vehicle other than an authorized emergency vehicle on official business shall not follow any fire apparatus traveling in response to a fire alarm closer than 500 feet or driving to or park such vehicle within 500 feet of fire apparatus which stopped in answer to a fire alarm.

activation.condition: For a motor vehicle driver, either a fire apparatus is traveling in response to a fire alarm or it has stopped in answer to a fire alarm. Alarm purpose is a separately sourced scene premise.

obligation.description: Do not follow the traveling apparatus closer than 500 feet; do not drive to or park the vehicle within 500 feet of the stopped apparatus. Retain branch-specific distance definitions and original-frame measurements.

exceptions.trigger: The subject is an authorized emergency vehicle on official business.
exceptions.effect: The stated prohibition does not govern that subject while the exception holds.
exceptions.source_clause: other than an authorized emergency vehicle on official business

timing.description: Observe the traveling-follow interval or the drive-to/park interval while the apparatus has the stated alarm-response status.

parameter_refs.name: fire_following_gap_ft
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: measured nonnegative ground-footprint separation in ft

parameter_refs.name: fire_stopped_distance_ft
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: measured nonnegative world-centre separation in ft

boundary_note: The stopped-branch phrase "within 500 feet" is represented with an inclusive equality probe for planning; exact legal meaning and physical equality require later review. No fixture establishes a legal interpretation.
